Growth & demand: Company Overview Statutory Reports Financial Statements Annual Report 2025-26 Accent Microcell's FY 26 performance reflects a revenue growth of 31.92%, PAT growth of 32.65% and EBITDA growth of 31.34%.

The pharmaceutical sector is a core demand driver for pharmaceutical products and it recorded exports of approximately US$ 31.11 billion in FY 26, compared to US$ 30.38 billion in FY 25, maintaining India's position as the world's third-largest producer of pharmaceuticals by volume, supplying approximately 20% of global generic medicine demand.

India supplies approximately 20% of the world's generic medicines by volume, and approximately 50% of US generic demand creating a deeply embedded structural demand for high-quality, pharmacopoeia-compliant excipients.
Margins & costs: Reconfiguration Under Tariff Pressures Inflation and Monetary Conditions Global headline inflation continued its downward trajectory in FY 26, easing to approximately 4.2% in 2025 and projected to moderate further to 3.6% by 2026, according to IMF estimates.

Company Overview The Company operates two fully certified manufacturing facilities, Unit I at Pirana, Ahmedabad (2,000 MTPA; 100% utilisation) and Unit II at Dahej SEZ, Bharuch (7,200 MTPA; 95% utilisation) with a combined installed capacity of 9,200+ MTPA.
EBITDA margin was maintained at 18.18% (FY 25: 18.26%), a marginal compression of 8 basis points reflecting continued prudence in cost management even as the Company scaled revenues significantly.
Capex & expansion: Upon commissioning, the new unit will increase our installed capacity to 12,000 MTPA, up from the current 9,600 MTPA, reinforcing our ability to meet growing customer demand and support future growth.

CAPACITY EXPANSION A New Nucleus of Growth Unit III - The Specialty Excipients Platform The commissioning of Unit III at Nayka (Kheda), Gujarat represents the most significant capacity investment in Accent Microcell's history.

Unit III at Nayka, Kheda, with planned capacity of 2,800 MTPA dedicated to the manufacture of Croscarmellose Sodium (CCS), Carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) and Sodium Starch Glycolate (SSG), is progressing toward commercial commissioning, with trial runs underway as at the date of this Report.
Balance sheet & cash: 3,695.32 lakh (17.62% margin) and H1 FY Financial Performance In FY 2025-26, the Company delivered the highest revenue, highest EBITDA and highest PAT in its history, a trifecta that reflects not merely topline growth but structural improvement in revenue quality, operating leverage and financial health.
The Company remained essentially debt-free, with a Debt-to-Equity ratio of 0.01x, ensuring minimal financial risk and substantial headroom for future capital deployment.
